notes: How every gear look version (gear/<kind>/<item>/<folder>/, named by the item JSON's `variants`) is made, run by scripts/build-gear.mjs with scripts/gear-variant.py: retexture = a Meshy retexture of the item's source on its own UVs (production/assets/src/chars/master/gear/, credits spent once), recolour = the item's main cloth colour to R,G,B (shading kept), solid = a flat colour (8 x 8 base colour).
